commit_scope: Third alignment pass: CONTRIBUTING loses its link list; seventeen top-level docs no file reads and the doc of a removed workflow move to docs/retired; five workflows whose scripts are gone, whose runner is disabled, or whose audit parses shell words as tools are removed; the asset-modularity audit's missing import is healed.
evidence_refs: CONTRIBUTING.md: every link resolved (the compost session had already pointed them at living doors); the Key Documentation list is removed as asked — the arrival surfaces are the doors; the issue-tracker link stays.

docs/*.md inventoried by last touch and inbound links (git grep over code, docs, web and scripts, excluding audits, ledgers, lineage and generated indexes): seventeen pages had zero readers and dates from February to July 2026 (WORKBOOK, SITE_MAP, SOCIAL-LAUNCH, PROMPTS-AND-AB, WORKER-SERVICE, MVP-TARGET-LIST, PIPELINE_DESIGN, LOCAL-TOOL-GUARD, spec-proof-shapes, OLLAMA-CLAUDE-LOCAL, DEPLOYMENT-CHECKLIST, doorway-comprehension, TELEGRAM-CARD-CONTRACT, MVP-PILOT-ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST, WORKTREE-CONSOLIDATION-2026-03-06, two provider smoke task cards); they move to docs/retired/ with the reason appended to its README. PR-GATES-AND-PUBLIC-VALIDATION.md follows: it documents the change-contract workflow removed here and only retired or lineage pages named it.

Workflows read against the tree and their last runs: asset_value_update.yml (both scripts absent, schedule already disabled, last run April), auto-heal-deploy-gates.yml (script absent, dispatch-only, last run February), change-contract.yml (script absent, push trigger already disabled, last run March), hostinger-api-native-deploy.yml (dispatch-only, last run June, nothing names it), claude-code-host-runner-task.yml (dispatch-only, last run February, the host runner it needs is disabled on the Mac) — removed. external-tools-audit.yml with scripts/audit_external_tools.py and its registry: failing twice a week since 2026-10-16 because it takes the first word of every workflow run line as a tool (PY, REMOTE, [[, import, print …) and needs a hand-kept registry on every dependabot bump; removed, with its entry in config/start_gate_workflow_owners.json.

asset-modularity-drift.yml failed daily since 2026-10-19 with NameError: name 'ast' is not defined in api/app/services/inventory_service.py (line 4157 uses ast.parse without the import); `import ast` added; `python scripts/run_asset_modularity_audit.py` runs to its reading (blocking_assets 128 by category implementation) and exits 0.

Named, not changed: test.yml carries `if: false` since March ('re-enable after resolving CI-only ModuleNotFoundError'), so no workflow runs the API suite on a PR; run locally today the suite's first failure is /api/health 404 from the Python host, which #4117 moved to the native container. Whether to run the suite in CI again is a cost decision for the body, proposed separately.
Indexes regenerated (scripts/INDEX.md, MANIFEST.md, specs/INDEX.md, api/tests/INDEX.md, api/app/routers/INDEX.md); tests exercising inventory_service and the meeting traces: 20 passed.
